reviewed_by: Claude review of the unverified-OpenRouter context ceiling and silent prompt compression
reason: Two independent OpenRouter context-sizing defects. (1) Until a model's endpoints are verified, resolve_context_limits held every OpenRouter model to the flat 8,192-token floor, because the catalog's `context_length` is the maximum across endpoints and automatic routing may land on a smaller one. OpenRouter also publishes `top_provider.context_length` -- the window the primary route actually serves -- which the catalog parser was discarding. ModelDescriptor now keeps it as `primary_route_context_window`, and the unverified branch caps against that instead of the floor, so the first turn on a model is sized from OpenRouter's own primary-route figure rather than a number no model serves; the floor still applies when the field is absent. The same route publishes `max_completion_tokens`, already stored as max_output_tokens, so the companion 2,048-token output floor lifts with it. Verified route limits still win, and a configured ceiling still narrows. (2) OpenRouter enables context compression by default on endpoints of 8K or less, which silently drops the middle of an oversized prompt; Nebula sizes its own context and already recovers from a rejected request, so the chat payload now sends plugins:[{id:context-compression,enabled:false}] and takes the error instead. test_context pins the primary-route ceiling, the configured-ceiling narrowing and the verified-route precedence; test_providers pins the parsed field and that the plugin is disabled for OpenRouter and absent elsewhere.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests and no Playwright: nothing rendered changes. The Assistant context meter already reads capacitySource/routeLimitsRequired from the API and keeps showing an unverified OpenRouter model as estimated -- only the number it prints moves -- so no screenshot baseline or area selector applies. Its 'safe N-token ceiling' wording is now the primary-route figure rather than the floor; a copy change is left for the follow-up that pins routing, which is where the number stops being an estimate. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. tests/test_playwright_impact.py and tests/test_test_selection.py are not selected because neither the impact manifest nor the selection script changed. test_api and test_chat are excluded: the descriptor field is additive and both the capability-verify and chat recovery paths already round-trip descriptors opaquely. Two test_orchestration compaction tests fail on origin/main at f6f42a9 and are unrelated to this diff. No full suites.
